notes.title: Triumvora - Releasing this Wednesday, 24th September
notes.content:
Ready to return to the Sectors?


Triumvora releases on September 24th, which is just a few days away!



Gather all your friends and spread the news! (like this Creature)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/15ab6184e06816ce8422dc2cad617c4a5d69c091.gif"]


New features

Three New Sectors


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/ec6c6a061304ecddfc081f45f0e31a2f6e74b32b.png"]



The full game will let you rule over 4 Sectors in total (including Sector Zero from the demo), each with their unique look and music.


Powerful Crown Abilities


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/f372598f79cc67a61f8932d36a6b170f132f0f53.gif"]



Crowns don't just sit pretty on your head! They grant a Crown Ability, which is one of the strongest abilities your Creature can get. Each ability is closely tied to how you got the Aura in the first place.


Upgrading in Sector Runs


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/5338f68882406602d0162e9d9d66cb2da22652be.gif"]



Upgrades work differently now. Between Blocks, you can choose to spend all your Aura on a random Passive Effect, which remains active during the entire Sector run. Stack the same effect for god-like powers!


New Creature Personalities


Some Creatures will turn against their friends, and some will be annoyed if you attack their friends. Some will be generous. and some will waste Fruit just for the sake of it. Many interesting situations can arise, watch friends and enemies be made under your eyes!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/9360bc27f4693fd8413eeaa3d47f30b0b0d128d3.gif"]



Creatures seem to know there's a stirring for a new Ruler, so they have gotten smarter and stronger. But your average Creature is nothing compared to its Ruler...


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/b6d9d43560629fca8b6782c83d204163ce09e3cc.png"]Meet the Rulers


Sectors Rho, Gam and Bis are named after their respective Rulers. Each Sector is heavily influenced by its Ruler's personality:



Ruler Rho is hot-headed and indiscriminate, like the destruction in their Sector

Ruler Gam is the trio's social butterfly, who is more busy socializing than maintaining their Sector

Ruler Bis is less interested in their own pack, and more into overflowing Stockpiles



The old Rulers have misused their Crown powers for too long and it's up to you to overthrow them.



However, they won't go down easily. They are the strongest Creatures you can find in the Infinite City, and will foil your plans to attain Rulership.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/d36016ada40bb13ac5b3717c3ec8da2daef285b2.gif"]
Will you take them down for their precious Crowns?


I'm curious, what are you most excited for? I will be waiting in anticipation until the 24th!



See you then,

Bianca

notes.title: Update: Demo Version 1.3
notes.content:
It's been a week since the Demo's initial release, and the Creatures have learned some new tricks!





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/3b9ac23e720f52bb3e22b3f431f5a98c7516ecea.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/35e26957f6bb74bbef77e7b89b0a583b22d6bdaa.png"]



This update brings some new features, including:

The Void: The Deity no longer throws you back to the Title Screen after death. Get a small glimpse of their immaterial home in the Demo, and some words of encouragement.

Aura bonuses: extra Aura is now awarded after finishing a Block, depending on your performance.

More Creature behaviours: Creatures have gotten a bit smarter, friendlier, and (possibly) angrier when hungry. Try barking at your friends with C key/A button!

Removed friendly fire from allied NPC Creatures.

Various other bug fixes & improvements.

As always, please keep submitting bug reports and feedback, and if you played the Demo, consider leaving a review!



Until next,

Bianca
